hints.title: Word Boundary Matching
hints.text: Join Posts with Keywords ensuring that keywords match complete words within post content.

hints.title: Padded Substring Check
hints.text: Padding post content and keywords with spaces allows standard matching with space-delimited patterns.

hints.title: String Aggregation and Defaulting
hints.text: Group by post_id and aggregate distinct topic_id values in ascending order. If no topic matches, return `the specified ambiguous label`.

hints.title: GROUP_CONCAT Query Formulation
hints.text:
```sql
SELECT
    p.post_id,
    COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT k.topic_id ORDER BY k.topic_id SEPARATOR ','), 'Ambiguous!') AS topic
FROM Posts p
LEFT JOIN Keywords k
    ON CONCAT(' ', LOWER(p.content), ' ') LIKE CONCAT('% ', LOWER(k.word), ' %')
GROUP BY p.post_id;
```

complexity.notes: LEFT JOIN with like pattern matching checks all keywords against each post.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simple substring matching flags words embedded inside larger words incorrectly.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Grouping and sorting distinct topics uses temporary buffer proportional to matched topics.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate handles word boundary delimiter padding and COALESCE fallback.

solutions.approach: Left Join on Padded Keyword Match with Group Concat
solutions.code:
SELECT
    p.post_id,
    COALESCE(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT k.topic_id ORDER BY k.topic_id SEPARATOR ','), 'Ambiguous!') AS topic
FROM Posts p
LEFT JOIN Keywords k
    ON CONCAT(' ', LOWER(p.content), ' ') LIKE CONCAT('% ', LOWER(k.word), ' %')
GROUP BY p.post_id;

SELECT
    p.post_id,
    COALESCE(STRING_AGG(DISTINCT k.topic_id::TEXT, ',' ORDER BY k.topic_id::TEXT), 'Ambiguous!') AS topic
FROM Posts p
LEFT JOIN Keywords k
    ON CONCAT(' ', LOWER(p.content), ' ') LIKE CONCAT('% ', LOWER(k.word), ' %')
GROUP BY p.post_id;
